# Regularity for Navier-Stokes on T³ via Bounded Vorticity-Response Functionals

This file sets up some definitions and proves a collection of lemmas about vorticity bounds and
(Beale–Kato–Majda) time-integrals for Galerkin-type approximations of incompressible Navier–Stokes
on the three-torus `T3`.

**Warning:** at present, most analytic ingredients are introduced as `axiom`s (Moser/Gronwall/Sobolev
estimates, Fourier inversion/Parseval, and the implication from BKM finiteness to smoothness), so
this file should be read as a scaffold for the intended argument rather than a fully formalized
proof of global regularity.

## Main results

- `VorticityResponse`: structure encoding bounds for a temporal density
- `TemporalLifting`: temporal reparameterization `t = φ(τ)` with quantitative bounds on `deriv φ`
- `uniform_vorticity_bound`: uniform-in-`N` bound for the vorticity of the Galerkin approximations
- `bkm_coordinate_invariance`: invariance of the BKM integral under temporal reparameterization
- `bkm_finite_anyT`: finiteness of the BKM integral on any finite time interval
- `GalerkinLimit.smooth`: existence of a smooth spacetime solution (under the above axioms)

## References

- Beale, Kato, Majda (1984): Remarks on the breakdown of smooth solutions
- Sundman (1912): Mémoire sur le problème des three corps
